description: This file is a PHP source file defining an OpenCart controller class 'Sale' in the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Dashboard'. It contains methods for handling dashboard sale related functionalities such as displaying the sale dashboard, saving configuration settings, and retrieving sale data.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for the Sale dashboard extension in the OpenCart admin panel, responsible for displaying sales data, saving settings, and providing sale-related dashboards.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the sale dashboard form page, including loading language, setting the page title, breadcrumbs, configuration settings, and other layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX request to save dashboard sale settings, including permission checks, updating settings model, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns a string containing sale dashboard data, such as total sales for specific periods, percentage change, total sales value formatted with suffixes, and rendering the dashboard view.
